name: Screensaver Quick Actions
description: Quick Actions overlay for Kiosk Satellite screensavers and Fotoo, with entity pictures, percentage badges, custom order, and per-item Home Assistant/time visibility rules.
author: Local Kiosk Satellite project

settings.title: Show on
settings.description: Choose which screensavers show the action rail.

settings.title: Position
settings.description: Anchor point for the action rail.

settings.title: Layout
settings.description: Stack actions vertically or horizontally.

settings.title: Picture size
settings.description: Avatar/icon size for each item.

settings.title: Spacing
settings.description: Space between items.

settings.title: Opacity
settings.description: Opacity of the action rail.

settings.title: Show names and states
settings.description: Show friendly name and current state beside the picture.

settings.title: Item order
settings.description: Display order of configured slots, for example 4,1,2,3,5,6. Missing slot numbers are appended automatically.

settings.title: Item 1 display entity
settings.description: Entity used for picture, name and state.

settings.title: Item 1 action entity
settings.description: Entity activated when tapped. Leave empty to act on the display entity.

settings.description: Entity used for picture, name and state.

settings.title: Item 2 action entity
settings.description: Entity activated when tapped. Leave empty to act on the display entity.

settings.title: Item 1 visibility entity (optional)
settings.description: Optional Home Assistant entity that controls whether this Quick Action is visible.

settings.title: Item 1 visibility condition
settings.description: Active recognizes on, true, home, playing, open, detected, occupied and present. Time between does not need an entity.

settings.title: Item 1 visibility value
settings.description: Value used by the selected condition. Examples: playing, 30, 10..200, or 22:00-06:00.
